verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at the composed 7 anchor because its orderly nine-panel frame, restrained registry palette, and strong grid feel intentional, while sparse internal layouts and one visibly ambiguous streaming-wire junction keep it from reading as fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The 3×3 panel grid uses most of the locked frame, but oversized gaps between rows and substantial unused space inside nearly every panel create a mild dead-band effect.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Colors are restrained and largely registry-true: teal orchestration, pink model, blue memory, green delivery, yellow human/message, red guardrails, and gray infrastructure are consistently applied.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Failing: the green streaming route forms an unresolved corner/junction above the client stream and live output, making the merged directionality read like exposed routing machinery.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Panel boundaries and title tabs hold a disciplined grid, but object spacing and density vary awkwardly, with the connected top workflow much denser than the sparse, mostly disconnected lower panels.
